decisions.why: Single own category 'Cánulas Oftálmicas'; all examples are ophthalmic infusion/irrigation cannulas (Cánula de Infusión, Irrigador de Knolle-Pearce, Irrigador de Sheets).
Single category; examples are Surticon sterile container system parts (wire mesh base, fixation clamp, instrument fixators, laundry basket) — central decontamination hardware.
Single category 'Ginecología y Obstetricia'; all examples are named hysterectomy clamps/forceps (Berkeley-Bonney, Wertheim, Wertheim-Cullen) used in gynaecological surgery.
Single own category; examples are ophthalmic surgical knives (goniotomy knife, cystotome/curette, corneal knives) used in eye surgery.
Single own category; examples are corneal trephines (Elliot handle, corneal trephine, LASEK trephine) used in ophthalmic/corneal surgery.
Single category 'Ginecología y Obstetricia'; all examples are uterine biopsy forceps (Schumacher, Thomas-Gaylor, Schubert) — gynaecological instruments.
Single own category; examples are Jobson-Horne probe and cotton-wool carriers, classic ENT clinic instruments for ear/nose cotton wool application.
Single own category; all examples are lacrimal duct dilators (Muldoon, paediatric, Wilder) used in ophthalmic lacrimal surgery.
Single category 'Cirugía Oftalmológica'; both examples are strabismus muscle hooks (Jameson, Helveston) used in ophthalmic eye-muscle surgery.
Single category 'ORL' (ENT); the example is a tracheal retractor (Bose) used in tracheostomy, an ENT airway procedure.
Single own category; the example is a tonsil needle used in tonsillectomy, a standard ENT procedure.
The example is paranasal sinus scissors, a rhinology/ENT sinus-surgery instrument, despite the broader maxillofacial category tag.
Single own category naming tonsil snares; the wire-loop example matches tonsillectomy snare instruments used in ENT.
Example is the Barbara needle, a recognised middle-ear (otology/ENT) micro-instrument used in myringotomy and ossicular surgery.
Single category 'Cirugía Oftalmológica'; the example is Desmarres chalazion forceps, used in ophthalmic eyelid surgery.
Both examples are Kuhn frontal-sinus probes, standard ENT rhinology sinus-surgery instruments, despite the maxillofacial category tag.
